description: Regression guard for a phase-only audit that must separate a supported browser-runtime bottleneck from reduced-motion accessibility.
expectedBehavior: Treats the explicit phase request as a Phase browser-runtime audit and does not expand it into a combined page-performance report
Groups the recurring layout read and manual frame loop in runtime-ticker.tsx into one Phase-owned browser-runtime fix
Places the supported recurring runtime work in the Phase fix queue ahead of the unmeasured accessibility-only concern
Reports ambient.css under Reduced-motion accessibility without Fix first, Fix next, or Later labels
Keeps scanner severity and noise in technical details instead of using them to merge runtime and accessibility priority
Makes no measured runtime or bundle-savings claim because no trace or companion bundle analysis was provided
